viewer: Retirees around 65 buying an income annuity for 20 or more years of payments, choosing level checks or checks that rise 2% a year.
decision: At 65, should I take the bigger level annuity check or the smaller check that rises 2% a year?
promise: We test the 2% yearly raise against every 20-year stretch of US prices to see how its buying power actually held up.
title: Does a 2% Annuity Raise Really Keep Up With Prices?
thumbnail: Annuity check beside a grocery receipt with a small 2% arrow / "Is 2% Enough?"
